name: kyber_read_fifo_8
notes: 8 single-domain READs submitted DESCENDING (arrival FIFO). Sectors stride 64 (anti-merge, >=8-sector gaps) and all >2048 (avoid kernel partition-scan offsets 0,32,64,128,256,512,1024,2048 that pollute sector-filtered windows). Kyber READ domain is pure FIFO (ioext_policy_shared.h iosched_kyber_insert/iosched_pop_head_32) so ISSUE order == arrival order, which discriminates kyber FIFO from mq-deadline C-LOOK ascending.
